description: Confirm the green baseline and lay the shared design-token foundation for the mountain/forest glassmorphism redesign. Verify all four gates pass, then introduce the spec's mountain/forest palette tokens (--pp-forest/moss/leaf/mist/slate/stone/amber) and reusable glassmorphism utilities, harmonized with the existing alpine palette, keeping the THREE theme-source files (tailwind.config.ts, globals.css, lib/theme.ts) mutually consistent. This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on; it must not change any existing visual output enough to break tests.
steps: Put node on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". From frontend/, run `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run`, and `npm run build` and confirm the baseline is green (lint clean, 24 vitest passing, build ~22 routes). From backend/, run `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` and confirm clean + 255 passing. Record the baseline route count.

In frontend/app/globals.css, add the mountain/forest CSS custom properties from the spec to :root alongside the existing --color-* tokens: --pp-forest:#1b3b2a; --pp-moss:#4e7a3f; --pp-leaf:#7fb069; --pp-mist:#cfe3d4; --pp-slate:#243b35; --pp-stone:#0c1410; --pp-amber:#e5b25d. Do NOT remove or change the existing --color-* alpine tokens (other components depend on them).

In frontend/tailwind.config.ts, extend theme.colors with a `pp` color group mapping those same hex values (pp: { forest, moss, leaf, mist, slate, stone, amber }). Add a reusable boxShadow 'glass' (e.g. a soft layered shadow) and a backgroundImage 'glass-sheen' (subtle translucent gradient) for frosted panels. Keep all existing color scales, shadows, and backgroundImages intact so nothing regresses.

In frontend/app/globals.css @layer components, add a reusable `.glass-panel` utility class: translucent background (e.g. rgba based on --pp-mist / white), backdrop-filter: blur(...), 1px subtle border (rgba(207,227,212,.4)-style), rounded corners, and a soft highlight — the shared glassmorphism primitive the dashboard restyle (FEAT-003) will reuse. Add a `.glass-panel--dark` variant tuned for darker surfaces (sidebar/header) if useful. Document in a short comment that these tokens mirror the landing experience palette.

In frontend/lib/theme.ts, add the mountain/forest tokens to the exported `palette` object as a `pp` key (pp: { forest, moss, leaf, mist, slate, stone, amber }) so non-Tailwind code (charts/inline styles/tests) can import them, mirroring tailwind.config.ts and globals.css. Add a short comment noting the three files are the single source of truth and must stay consistent. Do NOT change existing palette keys, brand, navItems, or NavItem types in this feature.

Re-run lint, vitest, and build. Confirm still green and that existing tests (StatTile.test.tsx asserting Badge default 'text-forest-800'; deep-pages/sentinel tests) still pass. The token additions are additive and must not alter existing rendered classes.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` is clean, `npx vitest run` shows 24 passing, `npm run build` succeeds, `uv run pytest` 255 passing and `uv run ruff check .` clean — all confirmed as the recorded baseline.
globals.css :root defines all seven --pp-* tokens with the exact spec hex values, alongside the untouched existing --color-* tokens.
tailwind.config.ts exposes a `pp` color group with the same seven hex values plus a `glass` boxShadow and `glass-sheen` backgroundImage, with all pre-existing tokens intact.
globals.css provides a reusable `.glass-panel` component utility (and optional dark variant) usable by other components.
lib/theme.ts exports the pp palette tokens, keeping the three theme-source files mutually consistent.
After the changes, lint + vitest (24) + build all remain green with no change to existing test assertions.
verification: cd frontend && export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q
findings: Baseline confirmed green before changes: frontend `npm run lint` clean, `npx vitest run` 24 passing (6 files), `npm run build` succeeds with 22 generated static routes (/ + 19 pages + /login + /_not-found; no /landing route yet); backend `uv run ruff check .` clean and `uv run pytest -q` 255 passing. Baseline route count = 22. Additive token foundation added across the three mutually-consistent theme-source files: (1) app/globals.css :root now defines all seven --pp-* tokens (forest #1b3b2a, moss #4e7a3f, leaf #7fb069, mist #cfe3d4, slate #243b35, stone #0c1410, amber #e5b25d) alongside the untouched --color-* alpine tokens, and @layer components gains reusable .glass-panel plus .glass-panel--dark frosted-surface utilities (translucent bg, backdrop-filter blur+saturate with -webkit- prefix, 1px rgba(207,227,212,.4) border, rounded corners, layered + inset-highlight shadow). (2) tailwind.config.ts theme.extend.colors gains a `pp` group with the same seven hexes, boxShadow gains `glass`, and backgroundImage gains `glass-sheen`; all pre-existing color scales (forest/mist/pine/dawn/sky/slate/alert), shadows (ridge/tile/glow), and backgroundImages (hill-haze/forest-header/dawn-ridge) are intact. (3) lib/theme.ts palette export gains a `pp` key mirroring the hexes; brand, navItems, NavItem types, and existing palette keys unchanged. Post-change gates still green: lint clean, vitest 24 passing (StatTile Badge default 'text-forest-800' and deep-pages/sentinel assertions unchanged), build still 22 routes. Backend untouched. No regressions. Note for FEAT-002/003: glass surfaces (backdrop-filter, inset highlights) and the immersive landing's canvas/video/3D are browser-runtime-only and cannot be visually verified in this sandbox (no display, dev servers blocked) — verify statically + via build/lint. Committed on branch main.
